title: Anthropic Is Selling Opus 5.5 on the Long-Session Receipt

items.claim: Anthropic says Opus 5.5 is “priced and trained to optimize costs for how developers code now.”
items.note: The quoted wording is complete and matches the Anthropic excerpt exactly.

items.claim: Anthropic frames Opus 5.5 around coding sessions that are longer and use more context.
items.note: Supported by the source title and excerpt; the article’s broader strategic reading is presented as analysis rather than a confirmed performance fact.

items.claim: AWS says Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on AWS.
items.note: Supported by the cited AWS source title.

items.claim: The evidence package does not establish public API/cache pricing, task-level cost comparisons, benchmark results, region-level access, quotas, configuration details, or uniform costs.
items.note: These are appropriately qualified absence statements about the material available in the evidence package, not unsupported assertions of fact.

claim_check.reason: The article’s event-specific factual claims are supported by the cited Anthropic and AWS materials. Its conclusions about session economics, buyer behavior, lock-in, and possible competitive effects are framed as analysis, conditional reasoning, or general background rather than asserted event facts.

evidence_caveats: 核心 thesis 缺少直接表述或可复核成本数据，当前仅能作“厂商将成本优化与长编码会话绑定”的有限描述。
缺少 Opus 5.5 官方 API/Bedrock 定价与缓存计费一手页面，无法核验“编码账单”变化。
缺少长会话相对短会话的具体机制、基准或真实任务成本实验。
没有与该产品发布直接相关的独立报道或开发者实测，无法交叉验证厂商成本口径。
AWS 页面虽抓取成功，但摘录未抓到支持可用范围和配置细节的正文；纽约时报链接抓取失败，不能作为证据。
所有可用摘录未显示发布日期，时间线不能精确断言。
未见反例、限制条件或冲突报道，无法衡量“成本优化”是否只适用于特定工作流。
seo_title: Anthropic’s Opus 5.5 Bets on Long-Session Economics
seo_summary: Token price is no longer the whole story. Anthropic frames Opus 5.5 around the cost and reliability of long coding sessions.
